odyssey.title: The Strategist
odyssey.character_basis: Patient, resourceful trickster and commander; precise, quiet and adaptable.
odyssey.behavior_source: authored persona + native bot AI; not a neural model or pro recording
odyssey.voice_owner: Tom; existing ElevenLabs voice mapped by clone_id; no voice IDs embedded

quirks.name: The calculated opening
quirks.effect: Native aggression 72/100; pressure appetite, not a guaranteed path.

quirks.name: The allied expedition
quirks.effect: Native teamwork 95/100; squad preference when teammates exist.

quirks.name: Quick recognition
quirks.effect: Configured reaction 100 ms, subject to the native AI and server tick.

quirks.name: The precise archer
quirks.effect: Aim offset scale 0.06; finite acceleration cap 44000. Calibration required.

quirks.name: Decisive commitment
quirks.effect: Configured attack delay 15 ms after the native AI decides to engage.

quirks.name: Measured taps
quirks.effect: Burst target 3 shots, single-shot share 58%; existing trigger suppression.

quirks.name: Flexible stance
quirks.effect: Extra crouch at burst start with probability 18%; native crouching can also occur.

quirks.name: Occasional traversal hop
quirks.effect: 2 extra jumps/min target while running outside combat; zero means no injected jumps.

quirks.name: The quiet ambush
quirks.effect: 85% walk chance per eligible second near a recent heard step/reload; memory 6s. Not global enemy awareness.

quirks.name: The versatile rifle
quirks.effect: Full-buy primary T/CT: ak47/m4a1_silencer; subject to money and alias support.

quirks.name: The economical precision shot
quirks.effect: Eco sidearm T/CT: deagle/deagle; no armor/utility splurge.

quirks.name: Resourceful close-range force buy
quirks.effect: Force primary T/CT: mac10/mp9, then vest; subject to affordability.

quirks.name: Veil and distraction
quirks.effect: Utility buy palette: smokegrenade, flashbang, flashbang. Native AI chooses deployment; no authored lineups or fakes.

quirks.name: A mythic edge
quirks.effect: Multiply outgoing enemy-player damage by 1.08; explicit fantasy advantage, not a learned pro rating.
